name: roshetta
description: AI-powered medical prescription reader (local MVP, simulated vision pipeline).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --workspace server run start" "npm --workspace client run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
